name: ECG-ID Database: Biometric Human Identification Benchmark
description: The ECG-ID Database is an electrocardiographic biometric benchmark compiled by Saint Petersburg State Electrotechnical University (LETI). It comprises 310 single-lead ECG recordings obtained from 90 volunteers (44 men and 46 women, aged 13 to 75). Recordings were acquired from the palms of the hands using non-invasive dry copper electrodes, with each recording lasting 20 seconds (sampled at 500 Hz with 12-bit resolution). Each subject contributed between 2 and 20 recordings collected across multiple days, providing intra-subject morphological variability for evaluating biometric identity verification and recognition models.
